props.name: confirm
props.comment: Ask for confirmation before the update.

props.name: guards
props.comment: Predicates keyed `"<from>-><to>"`. A transition with no guard is allowed.

props.name: labels
props.comment: Text for a state. A state with no entry shows as it is.

props.name: onTransition
props.type: (from: string, to: string, record: LooseRecord) => void
props.comment:
Runs once the update has resolved, or, in undoable mode, once the Undo
notification is queued. Not called when the update fails.

props.name: source
props.comment: Record field holding the status. Default `"status"`.

props.name: transitions
props.comment: The states each state may move to.
